attributes.board_name: Maine Board of Pharmacy (Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation)

rules.alternatives: Technicians certified to administer vaccines need 6 hours of ACPE-approved vaccine-related training to obtain that certification (renewed annually by form and fee).
rules.notes: License renews annually (expires December 31) by renewal form and fee, without a CE requirement. The Board's license page lists CE (15 hours) only for pharmacist license types; the technician entry and Board Rule Chapter 7 set no continuing education.
rules.rule_quote: Licenses may be renewed annually upon completion of a renewal application form supplied by the board and payment of the prescribed fee.
